title: Mindfulness
learning_outcomes: Explain awareness in the context of mindfulness.
Compare and distinguish practice types and evidence in the context of mindfulness.
Apply accessible exercises in the context of mindfulness.
Evaluate and justify decisions about discomfort and alternatives in the context of mindfulness.

lessons.title: Awareness
lessons.outcome: Explain awareness in the context of mindfulness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving awareness; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to practice comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain awareness from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of awareness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Practice types and evidence
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish practice types and evidence in the context of mindfulness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving practice types and evidence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to practice comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain practice types and evidence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of practice types and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accessible exercises
lessons.outcome: Apply accessible exercises in the context of mindfulness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accessible exercises; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to practice comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accessible exercises from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accessible exercises; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Discomfort and alternatives
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about discomfort and alternatives in the context of mindfulness.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving discomfort and alternatives; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to practice comparison.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain discomfort and alternatives from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of discomfort and alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of awareness; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of practice types and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accessible exercises; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of discomfort and alternatives; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
